blocks.en: Contents

blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 中文
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 識別符合GMP的URS必要組成項目
blocks.en: Identify the required components of a GMP-compliant URS

blocks.zh: 區分法規、操作與業務三類需求的差異
blocks.en: Distinguish between regulatory, operational and business requirements

blocks.zh: 用「可測試性」標準篩選URS條文
blocks.en: Screen URS clauses using the "testability" criterion

blocks.zh: 說明設施背景如何影響冷藏室需求
blocks.en: Explain how the facility context affects walk-in cold room requirements

blocks.zh: 為步入式冷藏室建立URS章節架構
blocks.en: Build a URS chapter structure for a walk-in cold room

blocks.zh: URS需求必須可被驗證——若無法為它設計測試，那你寫的只是一段說明，不是需求。
blocks.en: URS requirements must be verifiable. If you cannot design a test for it, what you have written is a description, not a requirement.

blocks.zh: URS Structure & Purpose — URS的結構與目的
blocks.en: URS Structure & Purpose

blocks.zh: 解說與CDMO應用 Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary & CDMO Application

blocks.zh: 為什麼URS如此關鍵？
blocks.en: Why Is the URS So Critical?

blocks.zh: URS是整個設備資格驗證的起點。IQ/OQ/PQ的每一個測試項目都應回溯至URS中的特定需求。若URS寫得模糊，後續驗證就無從追溯。
blocks.en: The URS is the starting point of the whole equipment qualification effort. Every IQ/OQ/PQ test item should trace back to a specific requirement in the URS. If the URS is vague, later validation cannot be traced.

blocks.zh: URS的三層需求
blocks.en: The Three Tiers of URS Requirements

blocks.zh: 法規需求 (Regulatory): 21 CFR Part 11、EU GMP Annex 11 — 必須滿足，不可妥協
blocks.en: Regulatory requirements (Regulatory): 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11 — must be met, non-negotiable

blocks.zh: 業務需求 (Business): 容積、電力規格 — 來自操作現實
blocks.en: Business requirements (Business): capacity, electrical specifications — derived from operational reality

blocks.zh: 操作需求 (Operational): 排班方式、清潔週期 — 決定日常使用限制
blocks.en: Operational requirements (Operational): shift patterns, cleaning cycles — determine day-to-day usage constraints

blocks.zh: CDMO多客戶情境
blocks.en: The CDMO Multi-Client Scenario

blocks.zh: CDMO環境中，同一台冷藏室可能存放多個客戶的GMP材料，每位客戶對溫度範圍、進出頻率、鑑別系統的要求不同。URS必須反映「最嚴格的共同標準」，而非單一客戶需求。
blocks.en: In a CDMO, the same cold room may store GMP materials for several clients, and each client has different requirements for temperature range, access frequency and identification systems. The URS must reflect the "strictest common standard" rather than the requirements of a single client.

blocks.zh: 常見陷阱
blocks.en: Common Pitfall

blocks.zh: "The system shall maintain proper temperature" — 這不是需求，是期望。正確寫法：「系統須將內部溫度維持在2°C至8°C，在最大負載條件下穩定時間不超過30分鐘。」
blocks.en: "The system shall maintain proper temperature" is not a requirement but an expectation. The correct wording: "The system shall maintain the internal temperature at 2°C to 8°C, with a stabilization time of no more than 30 minutes under maximum load conditions."

blocks.zh: Practice Questions 練習思考
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一份URS的「目的」欄位說「提供GMP儲存空間」——請指出至少兩個問題，並改寫。
blocks.en: The "Purpose" field of a URS says "Provide GMP storage space." Identify at least two problems and rewrite it.

blocks.zh: CDMO同時服務兩個客戶，客戶A要求2–8°C、客戶B要求-20°C。如何在同一份URS中處理這個衝突？
blocks.en: A CDMO serves two clients at the same time: client A requires 2–8°C and client B requires -20°C. How would you handle this conflict in a single URS?

blocks.zh: 「主要功能」提到monitoring system提供paging。這項需求屬於哪一層（法規/業務/操作）？為什麼？
blocks.en: The "Main Functions" section mentions that the monitoring system provides paging. Which tier (regulatory/business/operational) does this requirement belong to, and why?

blocks.zh: Applicable GMP Requirements & Regulations — 適用GMP法規要求
blocks.en: Applicable GMP Requirements & Regulations

blocks.zh: 不要只列法規名稱
blocks.en: Do Not Just List Regulation Names

blocks.zh: 直接引用「21 CFR Part 11」不算需求——你必須說明哪個具體要求適用於這套系統。例如：「電子溫度記錄不可被修改，修改必須留下審計軌跡（audit trail）」。
blocks.en: Simply citing "21 CFR Part 11" is not a requirement. You must state which specific requirement applies to this system. For example: "Electronic temperature records shall not be modifiable, and any modification must leave an audit trail."

blocks.zh: CDMO常見適用法規
blocks.en: Regulations Commonly Applicable to a CDMO

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11 — 電子記錄/電子簽章（若系統產生ER/ES）
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic records/electronic signatures (if the system generates ER/ES)

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 11 — 電腦化系統驗證
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 11 — Computerised system validation

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 — 風險管理（影響警報優先級設定）
blocks.en: ICH Q9 — Risk management (affects alarm priority settings)

blocks.zh: USP <1079> — 良好儲存與運輸實踐
blocks.en: USP <1079> — Good storage and distribution practices

blocks.zh: Guide的聰明建議
blocks.en: The Guide's Smart Advice

blocks.zh: 將法規轉化為業務語言。「有條碼標示的儲存位置」比「符合庫存管理系統要求」更具體、更可測試。這是ISPE指南的核心立場：requirements should be outcome-focused, not regulation-quoting.
blocks.en: Translate regulations into business language. "Storage locations identified by barcode labels" is more specific and more testable than "compliant with inventory management system requirements." This is the core position of the ISPE Guide: requirements should be outcome-focused, not regulation-quoting.

blocks.zh: Capacity, Pallet Racking & Construction — 容積、棧板架與建造需求
blocks.en: Capacity, Pallet Racking & Construction

blocks.zh: 容積需求的計算邏輯
blocks.en: The Calculation Logic of Capacity Requirements

blocks.zh: 「12個Euro棧板」必須綁定到實際尺寸（X×Y×Z）。若URS只寫數量而沒有尺寸，供應商可能設計出形狀無法放入任何標準棧板的空間。
blocks.en: "12 Euro pallets" must be tied to actual dimensions (X×Y×Z). If the URS states only the quantity and no dimensions, the supplier may design a space whose shape cannot fit any standard pallet.

blocks.zh: 單次入庫量的重要性
blocks.en: Why the Single-Delivery Quantity Matters

blocks.zh: 「最大單次入庫4棧板」是一個關鍵的熱負荷（thermal load）參數。這個數字直接影響OQ中的溫度恢復時間測試設計。若URS未定義，驗證就無法設計最差情況（worst case）。
blocks.en: "Maximum single delivery of 4 pallets" is a key thermal load parameter. This figure directly shapes the design of the temperature recovery time test in OQ. If the URS does not define it, validation cannot be designed around the worst case.

blocks.zh: GMP Grade棧板架的實際要求
blocks.en: Practical Requirements for GMP-Grade Pallet Racking

blocks.zh: 「無縫隙（crevice free）」和「耐殺孢劑（sporicidal agents）」是具體可測試的材料規格。可接受PVC塗層鋼架或不鏽鋼，但需在DQ階段提供材料證明。
blocks.en: "Crevice free" and "resistant to sporicidal agents" are specific, testable material specifications. PVC-coated steel racking or stainless steel is acceptable, but material certification must be provided at the DQ stage.

blocks.zh: 安全需求不只是OSHA問題
blocks.en: Safety Requirements Are Not Only an OSHA Issue

blocks.zh: 「從內側開門」的機制是法規要求，但在CDMO場所更需要考慮：操作員進入冷藏室時是否有人員追蹤系統？緊急按鈕連接的警報是否覆蓋24小時？
blocks.en: A mechanism to "open the door from the inside" is a regulatory requirement, but at a CDMO site there is more to consider: is there a personnel tracking system when an operator enters the cold room? Does the alarm connected to the emergency button cover 24 hours?

blocks.zh: 「最大單次入庫4棧板」這項需求，應該在OQ的哪個測試中被驗證？請設計測試標題與接受標準。
blocks.en: In which OQ test should the requirement "maximum single delivery of 4 pallets" be verified? Design the test title and acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: 若CDMO有兩個客戶，一個用Euro棧板、一個用美式棧板，URS應如何處理這個差異？
blocks.en: If a CDMO has two clients, one using Euro pallets and the other US pallets, how should the URS handle this difference?

blocks.zh: 「耐殺孢劑」需求如何在DQ文件中被確認？需要哪些供應商文件？
blocks.en: How is the "sporicidal agent resistance" requirement confirmed in the DQ documentation? Which supplier documents are needed?

blocks.zh: Process, Monitoring & Automation Requirements — 製程、監控與自動化需求
blocks.en: Process, Monitoring & Automation Requirements

blocks.zh: 「作業範圍」vs「驗收標準」的區別
blocks.en: The Difference Between "Operating Rate" and "Acceptance Criteria"

blocks.zh: URS中必須明確區分：operating rate（設備目標操作溫度）vs operating range（接受標準/規格上下限）。這兩者分別對應OQ的正常操作驗證與PQ的最差情況驗證。
blocks.en: The URS must clearly distinguish between the operating rate (the equipment's target operating temperature) and the operating range (the acceptance criteria/specification upper and lower limits). These correspond respectively to normal-operation verification in OQ and worst-case verification in PQ.

blocks.zh: 警報系統架構的GMP意義
blocks.en: GMP Significance of the Alarm System Architecture

blocks.zh: Level 1（Low/High）: 提醒操作員注意趨勢
blocks.en: Level 1 (Low/High): alerts the operator to a trend

blocks.zh: Level 2（Low-Low/High-High）: 需要立即行動的GMP偏差
blocks.en: Level 2 (Low-Low/High-High): a GMP deviation that requires immediate action

blocks.zh: DCS整合: 確保警報記錄進入21 CFR Part 11管轄的審計軌跡
blocks.en: DCS integration: ensures alarm records enter the audit trail governed by 21 CFR Part 11

blocks.zh: 獨立監控系統的重要性
blocks.en: Why an Independent Monitoring System Matters

blocks.zh: URS特別要求「獨立」（independent）的溫度監控系統。這意味著監控傳感器不能與設備的控制感測器共用電路——兩個系統必須能夠互相驗證。這是FDA檢查員常見的查核點。
blocks.en: The URS specifically requires an "independent" temperature monitoring system. This means the monitoring sensors must not share circuits with the equipment's control sensors, and the two systems must be able to cross-check each other. This is a common point of inspection for FDA inspectors.

blocks.zh: 感測器接口（Access Port）
blocks.en: Sensor Access Ports

blocks.zh: 要求「出廠時預裝感測器接口」是一個聰明的設計選擇。若在冷藏室建造完成後才鑽孔安裝接口，需要重新驗證密封完整性，既費時又有風險。
blocks.en: Requiring "sensor access ports pre-installed at the factory" is a smart design choice. If ports are drilled after the cold room has been built, the seal integrity must be revalidated, which is both time-consuming and risky.

blocks.zh: 資料完整性：「不可修改」要如何驗證？
blocks.en: Data Integrity: How Do You Verify "Not Modifiable"?

blocks.zh: 「記錄數據不可被修改」必須在URS中補充：（1）系統如何防止修改（技術控制），（2）若需更正如何留下審計記錄（21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e)）。這兩點都需要在OQ中測試。
blocks.en: The requirement "recorded data shall not be modifiable" must be supplemented in the URS with: (1) how the system prevents modification (technical controls), and (2) how an audit record is left when a correction is needed (21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e)). Both points must be tested in OQ.

blocks.zh: URS中要求「High-High alarm」，請寫出這個警報的具體觸發條件（溫度值）和系統回應（需要哪些自動動作？）
blocks.en: The URS requires a "High-High alarm." Write out the specific trigger condition (temperature value) and the system response (which automatic actions are needed?).

blocks.zh: 「獨立監控系統」與設備控制系統需要分開驗證嗎？各需要什麼文件？
blocks.en: Do the "independent monitoring system" and the equipment control system need to be validated separately? What documentation does each need?

blocks.zh: 若CDMO客戶要求數據存取日誌（access log），這應該放在URS哪個子章節？屬於哪一層需求？
blocks.en: If a CDMO client requires a data access log, which URS subsection should it go in? Which tier of requirement is it?

blocks.zh: Sample URS — Sections 1–3: Scope, Definitions & References — 範例URS：範圍、定義與參考文件
blocks.en: Sample URS — Sections 1–3: Scope, Definitions & References

blocks.zh: 「描述要達成什麼，不是如何達成」
blocks.en: "Describe What Is to Be Achieved, Not How"

blocks.zh: 範例URS第1節清楚說明：這份文件不規定如何達成需求。這是URS與DS（Design Specification）的核心差異。若URS開始指定品牌、型號或工程方法，就越界了。
blocks.en: Section 1 of the sample URS states clearly that the document does not prescribe how the requirements are to be met. This is the core difference between a URS and a DS (Design Specification). If the URS starts to specify brands, models or engineering methods, it has overstepped.

blocks.zh: Living Document原則
blocks.en: The Living Document Principle

blocks.zh: URS應隨設備生命週期更新。CDMO常見問題：設備使用5年後功能擴充，但URS從未更新，導致後續驗證失去追溯依據。建議在URS末尾設立「Change Summary」章節（範例已包含此節）。
blocks.en: The URS should be updated over the equipment lifecycle. A common CDMO problem: after 5 years of use the functionality has been expanded, but the URS was never updated, so later validation loses its traceability basis. It is advisable to include a "Change Summary" section at the end of the URS (the sample already includes this section).

blocks.zh: 定義章節的作用
blocks.en: The Role of the Definitions Section

blocks.zh: CDMO與客戶常因術語不一致產生誤解。在URS中明確定義「SME」的組成（QA、工程、驗證、生產）可以避免後續驗收時的責任爭議。RTD的定義對於監控傳感器類型選擇至關重要。
blocks.en: CDMOs and clients often misunderstand each other because of inconsistent terminology. Defining the composition of the "SME" in the URS (QA, engineering, validation, production) can avoid disputes over responsibility at later acceptance. The definition of RTD is critical for choosing the type of monitoring sensor.

blocks.zh: References節不能留空
blocks.en: The References Section Must Not Be Left Empty

blocks.zh: 許多公司在此填「N/A」。實際上應列出：適用的FDA指引、EU GMP附錄、場所SOP編號、以及設備供應商的技術標準。這些文件是DQ期間的核心審查資料。
blocks.en: Many companies enter "N/A" here. In practice it should list the applicable FDA guidance, EU GMP annexes, site SOP numbers and the equipment supplier's technical standards. These documents are core review material during DQ.

blocks.zh: Sample URS — Section 4: System Description — 系統描述
blocks.en: Sample URS — Section 4: System Description

blocks.zh: System Description的驗證功能
blocks.en: The Validation Function of the System Description

blocks.zh: 這個章節定義了系統邊界（System Classification Boundary）。邊界內的設備都需要被納入驗證範圍（IQ）。注意：冷藏系統與BMS的介面（interface）也需要被驗證，包括數據傳輸的正確性與完整性。
blocks.en: This section defines the System Classification Boundary. All equipment within the boundary must be included in the validation scope (IQ). Note that the interface between the refrigeration system and the BMS must also be validated, including the correctness and completeness of data transmission.

blocks.zh: P&ID的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of the P&ID

blocks.zh: 「TBA（To Be Announced）」P&ID在URS階段是可接受的。但在DQ結束前必須確定P&ID編號，因為IQ需要以實際P&ID為基礎進行安裝確認。
blocks.en: A "TBA (To Be Announced)" P&ID is acceptable at the URS stage. But the P&ID number must be fixed before DQ is complete, because IQ needs the actual P&ID as the basis for installation verification.

blocks.zh: CDMO的BMS整合挑戰
blocks.en: BMS Integration Challenges for a CDMO

blocks.zh: CDMO場所通常有多個客戶的設備共用BMS。URS應明確指出：冷藏室數據在BMS中的存取權限設定（哪些客戶可以看到哪些警報）以及數據隔離要求。
blocks.en: A CDMO site often has equipment from several clients sharing the BMS. The URS should state clearly the access permission settings for cold room data in the BMS (which clients can see which alarms) and the data segregation requirements.

blocks.zh: 「緊急出口門由手動推桿啟動」
blocks.en: "The emergency exit door is operated by a manual push bar"

blocks.zh: 這個設計規格看似簡單，但需要在IQ中驗證安裝正確，在OQ中測試功能（包括停電情況下）。若URS沒有列出這個元件，可能被遺漏在驗證範圍之外。
blocks.en: This design specification looks simple, but installation must be verified in IQ and function must be tested in OQ (including under power failure). If the URS does not list this component, it may be left outside the validation scope.

blocks.zh: Sample URS — Section 5: Capacity & Product Requirements — 容積與產品需求
blocks.en: Sample URS — Section 5: Capacity & Product Requirements

blocks.zh: 編號需求（Numbered Requirements）的價值
blocks.en: The Value of Numbered Requirements

blocks.zh: URS 5.1、5.2、5.3等編號是驗證追蹤矩陣（Traceability Matrix）的基礎。每個IQ/OQ/PQ測試項目都必須指向至少一個URS ID。若需求沒有編號，可追溯性就無法建立。
blocks.en: The numbering in URS 5.1, 5.2, 5.3 and so on is the basis of the validation traceability matrix. Every IQ/OQ/PQ test item must point to at least one URS ID. If requirements are not numbered, traceability cannot be established.

blocks.zh: Shall / Must: 強制需求，驗證必須確認
blocks.en: Shall / Must: mandatory requirement; validation must confirm it

blocks.zh: Should: 建議/目標，可接受例外但需記錄理由
blocks.en: Should: recommendation/target; exceptions are acceptable but the rationale must be documented

blocks.zh: 5.2使用「should」（設計條件）而5.1使用「must」（硬性要求）——這個語言選擇是刻意的，CDMO工程師需要理解其差異。
blocks.en: 5.2 uses "should" (a design condition) while 5.1 uses "must" (a hard requirement). This choice of language is deliberate, and CDMO engineers need to understand the difference.

blocks.zh: 外部設計條件（External Design Conditions）
blocks.en: External Design Conditions

blocks.zh: -2.8°C至36.7°C的外部溫度範圍來自ASHRAE標準，代表設備所在地區（如美國）的氣候極值。這個數字影響冷藏系統的冷凍容量（refrigeration capacity）計算——是IQ的基礎技術參數。
blocks.en: The external temperature range of -2.8°C to 36.7°C comes from ASHRAE standards and represents the climatic extremes of the region where the equipment is located (for example, the US). This figure affects the calculation of the refrigeration capacity of the cooling system and is a fundamental technical parameter for IQ.

blocks.zh: 「地板不儲存物料」的GMP意義
blocks.en: The GMP Significance of "No Material Stored on the Floor"

blocks.zh: 不放地板是GMP預防措施（防潮、防污染、便於清潔）。但URS必須進一步指定：「所有貨架底部離地至少X公分，提供清潔工具進入空間。」這樣才算可測試的需求。
blocks.en: Keeping material off the floor is a GMP precaution (against moisture and contamination, and to facilitate cleaning). But the URS must go further and specify: "The underside of all shelving shall be at least X cm above the floor, leaving space for cleaning tools to reach." Only then is it a testable requirement.

blocks.zh: 需求5.2使用「should」，若供應商無法達到-2.8°C的外部設計條件，需要什麼文件來記錄這個例外？
blocks.en: Requirement 5.2 uses "should." If the supplier cannot meet the external design condition of -2.8°C, what documentation is needed to record this exception?

blocks.zh: 5.2的「Product Physical Properties」章節在CDMO環境下應包含哪些欄位？請列出至少5項。
blocks.en: What fields should the "Product Physical Properties" section of 5.2 include in a CDMO setting? List at least 5.

blocks.zh: 如何在追蹤矩陣中將URS 5.1連結到OQ測試？請寫出對應的OQ測試標題。
blocks.en: How do you link URS 5.1 to an OQ test in the traceability matrix? Write the corresponding OQ test title.

blocks.zh: Good vs. Poor URS Requirement — 好需求與差需求對照表
blocks.en: Good vs. Poor URS Requirement

blocks.zh: The table below illustrates the principle: every URS statement must be verifiable. A poor requirement describes an intent; a good requirement defines a measurable outcome. 以下對照表體現核心原則：每條URS陳述必須可被驗證。差需求描述意圖；好需求定義可量化的結果。
blocks.en: The table below illustrates the principle: every URS statement must be verifiable. A poor requirement describes an intent; a good requirement defines a measurable outcome.
